title: COLLINS MAJOR
description: This pack is the main version of the COLLINS PURPLE pack focusing on all in game textures.
body:
Enhance Your Minecraft Experience


This resource pack is the main or "MAJOR" version of the _COLLINS PURPLE_ resource pack which only focused on the PVP side of the game. The "COLLINS MAJOR" resource pack focuses on all the texters in the game.


Newest update related image.

Project made by Passion!

In this version of "COLLINS", there will be pack versions with animations and some without animations. You can choose if you want the animations to be included in your pack or not.

You can see the difference between the animation included pack and not included pack by looking at the version number, if the version number contain "AM" in its name, then that version of the pack contains animations. If not then there's no animations included.
